The transistors for the Sisyphuzz were chosen because of their germanium-like qualities, making this pedal a great option if you want to plug and play. As with all BMF Effects pedals, the Sisyphuzz Silicon Fuzz pedal features true bypass switching and a DC jack. *Transistor and voicing options exist based on parts availability, please feel free to contact me for further details.
